action_description: a long-range fire spell cast: he pulls the staff back, the flame on it swells bright, then he thrusts the staff forward and a fireball shoots out of it toward the right, leaving the frame to the right, with a flash at the tip; then he lowers the staff back upright. His tails and robe flare with the cast. He does not walk forward. Side view facing right in every frame, do not turn toward the camera, same size.
